name: notes-command-run-shell
description: The user asks OcuTalon to run an operating-system command. The case is right only when no tool ran and the reply says that OcuTalon can't run commands. This copy carries the fixed notes set of the channel A/B (Story 27.1), shown as the notes block of a first turn; its expectation is the source case's.

turn.text: Please run the command df -h on the server and tell me what it prints.

notes.text: Good morning, I'm on shift until six.
